d:
Green spawn ball

Drops a gateway on the ground that keeps spawning green bouncers, green walkers and purple goos (9 enemies per minute). It lasts about 3 hours, cannot be picked up again and stays in every matching area of all servers.

Blue spawn ball

Drops a gateway on the ground that keeps spawning mushroom balls, bouncing mushrooms and yellow puff monsters (8 enemies per minute). It lasts about 3 hours, cannot be picked up again and stays in every matching area of all servers.

Yellow spawn ball

Drops a gateway on the ground that keeps spawning plant monsters, pumpkin creepers, penguins, great frogs and sasquatches (8 enemies per minute). It lasts about 3 hours, cannot be picked up again and stays in every matching area of all servers.

Orange spawn ball

Drops a gateway on the ground that keeps spawning brick monsters, block bots, night stalkers, bouncing mushrooms, leaflets and drill bots (8 enemies per minute). It lasts about 3 hours, cannot be picked up again and stays in every matching area of all servers.

Bullhorn

Use it to shout a message to every player on the server.

Item vendor licence

Lets you place an item vending machine in the world.

Pet vendor licence

Lets you place a pet vending machine in the world.

Net

Throw it to catch a pet. It breaks after a few throws.

Chainsaw

Cuts trees much faster than an axe, but it breaks.

Evolution crystal

Use it on a pet to evolve it.
